scope: Fixed converged Taxol density; native resident CDERI built once. Synchronized full DF.get_jk includes factorization, unpack, occupied transform, Gram, Coulomb contractions and output assembly. Setup/build, patch installation, host copies and verification are excluded from J/K samples. One warmup per size then three pairs against 256 per candidate, alternating pair order. Ratios concern J/K only; no SCF, forces or workflow speedup is measured.
workspace_scope: FP64 dense AO unpack plus one occupied transform buffer only; excludes persistent CDERI, outputs, factors, allocator reservation and native-library workspaces.
